reviewNotes: Hosted by the home's website vendor and linked from johntrhinesfuneralhome.com/release-forms, so provenance is posted.

Direct cremation: the FTC-comparable line (with alternative container, cardboard box) is the one benchmark observation; the $3,100 no-container line and the cloth-covered-casket line are kept unmatched so this home counts once.

Immediate Burial/Graveside Service is a package (basic services, removal, certificate, transport), not a graveside-service fee, so it is unmatched; the graveside benchmark uses 'Funeral Director for Committal Service'.
Washing and disinfecting (no embalming) is not embalming and not cosmetology; unmatched. Body-prep uses cosmetics/dressing/hairstyling.
Viewing and service lines are priced 'at church or other facility' (this GPL lists no on-premises viewing line).
Caskets, outer burial containers and urns are ranges and never enter the benchmark feed.
Packaged offerings (Service Options A/B) and cash advances other than the DC death certificate are left out.

JOHN T. RHINES FUNERAL HOME
Washington, DC
GENERAL PRICE LIST
Prices are effective as of February 1, 2026, but are subject to change without notice.

PROF. SERVICES OF FUNERAL DIRECTOR, STAFF, AND OVERHEAD          $3,500.00
Non-Declinable Descriptive Listing of Services with Itemized Overhead Expenses
Our fee for the services of the funeral director and staff includes, but is not limited to, staff to
respond to initial request for services: arrangement conference with family or responsible party;
preparation and filing of necessary authorization and per mits; recording vital statistics; general
clerical administration in completing various forms associated with the service; filing and
obtaining death certificates and other forms and claims; notary service; coordination with those
providing other portions of the funeral , e.g. cemetery, crematory, clergy, and others. (The funeral
home has incorporated into the above fee a basic facility charge, which is used to meet overhead
expenses such as maintenance and utility expenses; parking lots and real estate tax es; insurance
and administrative expenses and government compliance.) The fee for ou r basic professional
services will be added to the total cost of the funeral arrangement you select. This fee is
included in our charge for direct cremation, immediate burials and forwarding and receiving
remains.

TRANSFER OF REMAINS FROM PLACE OF DEATH TO FUNERAL HOME
(Hospitals, Nursing Homes and Medical Examiner’s Office, Residence)                   $595.00
This fee is applicable to removal within a 40-mile radius of the funeral home. Additional mileage
will be charged at a rate of $2.00 per mile.

EMBALMING                                                                                          $995.00
Professional preservation; specialized care and handling of the deceased, including supplies.
Except in certain cases the law does not require embalming. Embalming may be necessary
however, if you select certain funeral arrangements, such as a funeral with  a viewing. If you do
not want embalming, you usually have the right to choose an arrangement that does not require
you to pay for it, such as immediate burial or direct cremation.

OTHER PREPARATION OF THE REMAINS
1. Washing and disinfecting remains (no embalming)   $595.00
2. Refrigeration of un-embalmed remains    $300.00
3. Restoration (case by case determination)    $250.00 & up
4. Cosmetics, Dressing, and Hairstyling (Men or Women)  $395.00
5. Coloring of hair (additional to hairstyling)    $195.00

8



ALTERNATIVE FUNERAL SERVICES

DIRECT CREMATION         $3,100.00
Our charge for a Direct Cremation without any ceremonies includes removal of remains, necessary
arrangements, filing of death certificate, transfer of remains to crematory and cremation. (If you
want to arrange a direct cremation, you can use an alternativ e container). Alternative container
encases the remains and can be made of fiberboard or composition material with or without outside
covering.

DIRECT CREMATION W/ ALTERNATIVE CONTAINER
Cloth covered Casket         $2,990.00
Cardboard Box         $2,690.00

IMMEDIATE BURIAL/GRA VESIDE SERVICE     $3,585.00
This charge includes removal of remains, basic services of the funeral director and staff, filing of
death certificate and transportation to the cemetery. Casket NOT included.

FORWARDING REMAINS TO ANOTHER FUNERAL HOME  $2,995.00
This charge includes basic services of funeral director and staff, removal of remains from place of
death, necessary services of staff, embalming filing of death certificate, air tray and transportation
to airport. This charge does not include visitation or funeral ceremony prior to the forwarding of
the remains.

RECEIVING REMAINS FROM ANOTHER FUNERAL HOME  $2,790.00
This charge includes transportation of remains to funeral home, temporary shelter of remains,
necessary services of staff and transportation to cemetery. This charge does not include visitation
or funeral ceremony and limousine service.

John T. Rhines Funeral Home makes no representation or warranties regarding the caskets or outer

John T. Rhines Funeral Home, hereby expressively disclaims all warranties, expressed or implied,
relating to the caskets, including but not limited to the implied warranties of merchantability and
fitness for a particular purpose.
